title: Health
description: Body mass index measured at the clinic and diabetes history, from questionnaire Section D, Health.

bmi.title: Body mass index (kg/m2)
bmi.description: Measured at clinic visit. Questionnaire D1: 'Body mass index recorded from measured height and weight.' Rounded to one decimal place in the 2024 release.
bmi.$comment: Source coding: number 12.0-70.0; -1 Not measured. Questionnaire D1: '(Clinic) Body mass index recorded from measured height and weight.' The author confirms -1 appears only for BMI, when the nurse could not measure (D010), and that BMI was rounded to one decimal place in the 2024 release (D030); the rounding is not enforced.

diabetes_dx.title: Ever told you have diabetes
diabetes_dx.$comment: Source coding: 1=Yes; 2=No; -9 Don't know. Questionnaire D2: 'Has a doctor ever told you that you have diabetes?'

diabetes_age.title: Age at diabetes diagnosis (years)
diabetes_age.$comment: Source coding: integer 10-85; -6 Not applicable; -9 Don't know. Notes: Asked only if diabetes_dx = 1. Questionnaire D3: 'IF YES: How old were you when you were told?' People whose diabetes_dx is don't know hold -6 here (D024).
diabetes_age.x-universe: People who were told by a doctor that they have diabetes (diabetes_dx = 1)
